messages:
sam_green: FYI Acme POC blocked — Okta complains "invalid SAML response: certificate chain" and SCIM POST /Users returns 403. Trying to finish SSO/SCIM onboarding for dedicated POC. Need quick remediation, they can't proceed with user sync.

alia_se: Can you paste the SAML metadata (IdP metadata XML) or the SP entityID they sent? Also are we SP‑initiated or IdP‑initiated for this tenant?

sam_green: IdP‑initiated. I have the metadata URL: https://acme.okta.com/app/redwood/sso/saml/metadata

marcus_sales: Heads up — dedicated POC is on our customer domain (private-ingress). Did we provision a cert that includes their SNI name? If not, Okta will reject the callback.

jen_prod: Checking logs… seeing TLS handshake failures: "tls: handshake failure" from 52.34.12.9. SNI in client hello = "acme.redwood-company.com" but cert SANs = "*.redwood-inference.com". Use openssl to reproduce:
```
openssl s_client -connect private-ingress.prod:443 -servername acme.redwood-company.com -showcerts
```

alia_se: Good catch. If the cert doesn't include the tenant hostname Okta will drop the response. For short term we can either 1) add their hostname as SAN to the cert, 2) use hosted redirect URL (redwood-hosted) while cert rotation happens, or 3) ask customer to use our hosted SSO callback domain.

sam_green: Customer is sensitive about data path, wants private but will accept a temporary hosted callback. Which option is fastest?

jen_prod: Fastest: use hosted callback. To do that update their SAML app Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) to https://sso.redwood-inference.com/saml/acs/<tenant_id>. If they insist on private, request their fullchain.pem + privkey and we'll upload via Console > Private > TLS > Upload (POC-only path). Need fullchain, not single cert.

ops_bot: scim-proxy: auth header missing for tenant=acmeinc, remote_addr=10.1.2.3

alia_se: SCIM 403 looks like missing auth header at our ingress. Does Okta send Authorization header or uses 'X-HTTP-Authorization' variant? Some proxies lower-case headers and our nginx config was strict.

jen_prod: Yep — we had a passthrough bug that dropped lowercase 'authorization' header when forwarding to the scim service. Quick fix is add `underscores_in_headers on; proxy_set_header Authorization $http_authorization;` in the proxy vhost, or apply patch we pushed to canary.

sam_green: Can we give them a curl test to verify once fixed?

alia_se: Use:
```
TOKEN=<their_scim_token>
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://private.acme.redwood-company.com/scim/v2/Users
```
Check for 200 and list of users.

jen_prod: After they uploaded fullchain + we patched header passthrough, logs show successful SAML post and no TLS alerts. SCIM calls now return 200 for GET /Users and Okta provisioning resumed.

marcus_sales: POC note: if they move to Dedicated we'd include SAN changes in onboarding checklist. Also pricing note — dedicated POC with custom certs is in the enterprise addendum, FYI.

sam_green: Closing — customer confirmed provisioning complete and user sync live. Thanks team :tada:
